title: morenia linearis
intro: Morenia linearis, commonly known as the Linearis, is a plant species within the family of Apocynaceae. It is a flowering plant that has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Morenia linearis include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever and alleviating pain.
